name: minion
description: Operate Minion (github.com/patrick-1984/ai-minion) from Claude Code: detect an installed minion or install it, start and pair a Worker with a Hub, list, read and type into terminal sessions, and act as a Minion master that controls sessions on other Workers once an administrator grants it. The skill is the same guide as "minion llm-help"; /minion:setup walks through install and pairing.
